About The No-Spill Spout
------------------------

Every day, in every corner of the world, valuable liquids are being spilled. These spills create frustrating mess and potential harm to the environment.  
  
But the days of spills are coming to an end.. soon we will introduce the future of pouring technology: the No-Spill Spout.  
  
This little spout has a big mission; to wipe out household, automotive, and workplace spills.  
  
Design meets science in effective, beautiful harmony.  
  
The No-Spill Spout is comprised of 3 pieces, the spout, a securing ring, and a cap. Each piece comes in a wide variety of colors so you can make your Spouts as unique as you are.  
  
The body of each spout is one solid piece of industrial-grade plastic with vents on both the top and bottom of the tube which allow the liquid to escape while air seamlessly fills its place. Gone are the days of “glug, glug, glug, splash”.  
  
From Elmer’s glue to SimpleGreen’s earth-friendly household cleaners, the No-Spill Spout fits over 150 of today’s most popular products in their 1 gallon forms.  
  
The No-Spill Spout™ works on virtually any 1 gallon jug, including those containing bleach, industrial cleaners, dish soap, lubricants and oils, radiator fluid and windshield wiping fluid.  
  
Commercial, automotive and marine products are all easy to pour with this durable and reliable product. The two-tier dispenser system prevents liquid from “glugging” and flowing out in spurts to cause splashes. The product can be used over and over again on various types of liquids by simply washing it out. The first vent allows for the liquid to flow while the second vent introduces air to make pouring smooth. An included cap keeps the product safe from spills while in storage.

The Indian Institute of Management Udaipur (IIMU), established in 2009, is a premier management institution located in Balicha, Udaipur, Rajasthan. The institute commenced its journey with a modest batch of 58 students in a temporary campus at Mohanlal Sukhadia University, Udaipur, and is set to expand into a sprawling 253-acre campus allocated by the Government of Rajasthan.  
  
Under the leadership of Chairman Shri C.K. Birla and Director Prof. Janat Shah, IIM Udaipur has quickly established itself as a hub for innovative management education. The institute offers a diverse range of programs, including its flagship Post Graduate Programme (PGP), a Dual Degree Post Graduate Programme for Executives in Global Supply Chain Management in collaboration with Purdue University's Krannert School of Management, and specialized programs like the Management Development Programme for Women Entrepreneurs. IIMU is also committed to research and development, aiming to introduce Doctoral and Faculty Development Programs in the near future.  
  
IIM Udaipur is dedicated to fostering a dynamic learning environment, with a focus on industry interaction and practical exposure. The faculty at IIMU comprises experienced educators and industry professionals, contributing to a rich academic experience. For those interested in the academic credentials and expertise of the faculty, a detailed Indian Institute of Management Udaipur teachers list is available on the official website. As IIMU continues to grow, it remains committed to setting new benchmarks in management education and contributing to the development of India's managerial workforce.

ReNew has enabled borrowers to obtain mortgages directly from a lender. Providing this “direct” access through “technology” was how “ReNew” was born.  
  
With a history of innovation and a commitment to always putting the customer first, ReNew is well positioned to grow even further in its status as a mortgage loan originator of choice. The company’s knowledgeable mortgage professionals are dedicated to making every customer’s home loan experience a positive and successful one.

About VIA University College
----------------------------

VIA University College is Denmark’s largest University College and covers all of Central Jutland.  
  
We have:  
\- Approx. 18,000 students  
\- More than 40 bachelor degree programmes  
\- Approx. 2,000 employees  
\- 7 campuses  
  
VIA University College is Denmark’s third-largest educational institution and offers bachelor degree programmes within the areas of health, social education, technology, trade, design, business and animation.  
  
VIA also offers continuing education and lifelong learning programmes and participates in various development activities in the region.  
  
VIA has cooperation-agreements with educational institutions almost all over the world and the focus is on student mobility, on cooperation between lecturers and on long-term development and research projects.  
  
VIA has 18 Research Centres which ensure that the focus is always on new and relevant knowledge in order to develop the bachelor degree programmes.  
  
VIA is a certified holder of an extended ERASMUS charter under the EU's Lifelong Learning Programme and is also an independent state-recognised Higher Education Institution. The study programmes are approved by the Danish Ministry of Education.

About American Biltrite Inc. Tape Products Division
---------------------------------------------------

ABI Tape is a division of American Biltrite Inc. Founded 1908, American Biltrite became one of America’s first tape manufacturers with their line of friction, rubber, and plastic tapes. For more than 100 years, we have worked tirelessly to perfect the art of tape manufacturing, to create a diverse line of products for a variety of markets all over the world. ABI Tape presently produces a range of pressure sensitive tapes for the Automotive, Graphics, HVAC, Insulation, Industrial, Shoe and Surface Protection markets.ABI Tape is headquartered in Moorestown, NJ, where its protective films and papers are manufactured. A second domestic manufacturing plant, Ideal Tape, is located in Lowell, MA, where products for the HVAC, Insulation, Industrial and Shoe markets are manufactured. ABI Tape operates converting facilities in Belgium, Singapore and Italy, as well as sales offices in Shanghai, Bangkok and Seoul, to better serve our customers all over the world.From top to bottom, ABI Tape is an organization committed to continual improvement and innovation. All of our products are designed in our fully equipped and expertly staffed Research & Development department, and are manufactured to the ISO 9001:2008 quality standards.At ABI Tape, we pride ourselves on our integrity, social responsibility, teamwork, and serving our customers the best we can.

What types of events does Eco Caters specialize in?

Eco Caters specializes in a wide range of events, including weddings, corporate gatherings, private parties, and pop-up dinners. With over 10 years of experience, we tailor our services to meet the unique needs of each event, ensuring that every occasion is memorable and delicious.

Do you offer organic catering options for corporate events?

Yes, Eco Caters provides organic catering options specifically designed for corporate events. We focus on seasonal, locally sourced ingredients to create healthy and flavorful meals that cater to various dietary preferences. Our corporate lunch delivery service is perfect for meetings, conferences, and employee appreciation events.

Can Eco Caters accommodate dietary restrictions and preferences?

Absolutely! At Eco Caters, we understand the importance of catering to diverse dietary needs. We offer a variety of options for vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and other dietary restrictions. Our team is dedicated to ensuring that all guests have delicious meal choices that meet their individual requirements.

What is the SoundBite Pop Up Dinner experience?

The SoundBite Pop Up Dinner is a unique dining experience offered by Eco Caters, where guests can enjoy a curated menu in a creative and intimate setting. These events feature seasonal ingredients and are designed to foster community and connection among attendees. Each dinner is a one-of-a-kind experience, often held in unique venues across San Diego, L.A., and the greater DC area.

How does Eco Caters handle venue management for events?

Eco Caters provides comprehensive venue management services to ensure your event runs smoothly from start to finish. Our team assists with venue selection, setup, coordination, and breakdown. We work closely with clients to understand their vision and ensure that every detail is executed flawlessly, allowing you to focus on enjoying your event.

What areas do you serve with your catering services?

Eco Caters proudly serves clients in San Diego, Los Angeles, and the greater Washington, D.C. area. Whether you're planning a wedding, corporate event, or private gathering, our team is ready to bring our organic catering expertise to your location, ensuring a delightful culinary experience for all guests.

Who are the decision makers in The RMH Group, Inc.?

What types of engineering services does The RMH Group offer?

The RMH Group provides a comprehensive range of engineering services, including mechanical, electrical, and industrial process engineering. Our specialties encompass sustainable design, cogeneration systems, healthcare facility design, mechanical and electrical design for higher education institutions, lighting solutions, and specialized services for industries such as aerospace, data centers, and laboratories.

How does The RMH Group approach sustainable design?

Sustainable design is a core focus at The RMH Group. We prioritize low-energy-use solutions and deep energy retrofits to enhance energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Our team employs innovative strategies, such as microgrids and cogeneration systems, to create sustainable and resilient infrastructure that meets the needs of our clients while promoting environmental stewardship.

What industries does The RMH Group serve?

The RMH Group serves a diverse range of industries, including healthcare, higher education, aerospace, data centers, industrial processes, and recreation facilities. Our expertise in critical facilities building systems and central utilities allows us to deliver tailored solutions that meet the unique requirements of each sector.

Can The RMH Group assist with projects involving central plants and utilities?

Yes, The RMH Group has extensive experience in designing and implementing central plants and utility systems. Our team specializes in high-performance mechanical and electrical engineering, ensuring that central plants are efficient, reliable, and capable of supporting the operational needs of various facilities, including hospitals, universities, and industrial sites.

What is the significance of IDIQ contracts in your services?

IDIQ, or Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity contracts, allow The RMH Group to provide flexible and efficient engineering services over a specified period. This approach is particularly beneficial for clients who require ongoing support for multiple projects or need to respond quickly to changing demands. Our experience with IDIQ contracts ensures that we can deliver high-quality services while maintaining responsiveness and adaptability.

How does The RMH Group ensure the success of its engineering projects?

The RMH Group employs a collaborative approach to project management, engaging closely with clients to understand their goals and requirements. Our team utilizes advanced engineering practices, thorough planning, and rigorous quality control measures to ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality. We also prioritize communication and transparency throughout the project lifecycle to foster strong client relationships.

About Radical Sportscars Ltd.
-----------------------------

Through continual product development, expansion into new markets and with a customer support framework previously unseen in the motorsport and track car industry, Radical Sportscars has now grown to become the world's largest producer of racing and track cars. Over 200 units leave Radical's Peterborough manufacturing base each year destined for customers across the globe. During the company's 18-year life it has written its own very successful chapter in race and road car manufacturing. This has included designing the world's favourite racing car, the SR3 RSX, designed and constructed its own racing-spec RPE V8 engine, contested Le Mans five times and driven around the Nürburgring Nordschleife faster than any other road registered and road-legal car (6m 48s). This, in addition to a host of other lap records and accolades from the global motoring press. Radical's continuing commitment to reducing the cost of racing saw a raft of changes in 2013 and 2014, including the launch of a new championship for novice racers, the SR1 Cup, which continues to be successful with a second successful season just completed and the champion crowned. At the opposite end of the scale, Radical's European Masters offers racing at Europe's best GP circuits with lap times comparable to LMP machinery but at far lower cost. The closed-cockpit RXC has been critically acclaimed by the motoring press for taking the Radical experience to a new, wider audience with a bigger platform and more advanced specification. The RXC V8 has already become a proven race winner against GT3-specification machinery costing over twice the price, and is rapidly gaining a reputation as the car to beat in Pro-Am GT, sportscar and endurance racing championships. There is a Radical sportscar racing ladder that can take drivers from trackdays all the way to Le Mans and Radical continues to produce the most focused yet accessible and affordable track and road cars available anywhere in the world.

This data-driven approach has led to the successful launch of new products that resonate with the evolving needs of consumers, helping Estée Lauder to maintain its position as a leader in the beauty industry.  
  
Jane Lauder's leadership as Chief Data Officer has also extended beyond the company's internal operations, as she has been a vocal advocate for data privacy and ethical data usage. In an era of increasing concerns about data security and consumer privacy, she has worked to ensure that Estée Lauder's data practices are transparent, compliant with regulations, and respectful of customer privacy. By prioritizing ethical data governance, Jane has helped to build trust with consumers and establish Estée Lauder as a responsible steward of customer data.  
  
With her passion for innovation, her deep understanding of the beauty industry, and her strategic use of data to drive business outcomes, Jane Lauder has established herself as a trailblazer in her role as Chief Data Officer of Estée Lauder. Through her leadership, the company has been able to harness the power of data to optimize operations, drive product innovation, and enhance the customer experience, positioning Estée Lauder for continued success in the fast-evolving beauty market.

About Coles Group
-----------------

At Coles Group, we’re all about our ‘why’ – our purpose – to sustainably feed all Australians to help them live healthier, happier lives. And in these current times, this has never been more important.  
  
Coles Group is one of Australia’s largest and most iconic retailers, with more than 2,400 outlets across our portfolio of Australian supermarkets, liquor and convenience stores. We have a proud history starting in 1914 when G.J. Coles opened our first store in Collingwood, Victoria.  
  
Today we have 120,000 team members who are making a difference, processing more than 21 million customer transactions each week, providing our customers with products from thousands of farmers and suppliers. We look ahead, energise each other and deliver with pride. These are the behaviours we exhibit when we’re at our best. Our team members are a diverse bunch and we authentically celebrate this at Coles Group - because a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture drives innovation, diversity of thought, new ideas and a better work environment for everyone.  
  
We have an important role to play in creating jobs, supporting our suppliers and making a positive difference in our Australian local communities. We provide a range of fresh food, groceries, general merchandise, liquor, and financial services.  
  
Our strategy is focused on changing at pace, efficiency and innovation, and we’re committed to having a positive impact on the lives of all Australians, now and into the future.

About Churchill Real Estate
---------------------------

Churchill Real Estate was established by professionals with a deep knowledge of the real estate sector including operational expertise in development and property management. Prior to forming Churchill, the founding partners had completed over $5 billion of debt and equity transactions in New York City.  
  
Churchill focuses on well-located, downside protected real estate as well as transactions with risk-mitigated capital structures. Churchill has been extremely selective in the transactions pursued, evaluating numerous factors including basis, risk-return parameters, and sponsorship. Churchill invests in both equity and debt positions of a capital stack and has consummated numerous successful partnerships in New York.  
  
Given the vertically integrated nature of the firm, Churchill is able to understand all investment considerations across the life-cycle of a transaction including identifying potential opportunities, initial acquisition, re-positioning/development, to stabilization and disposition. Given Churchill’s vast experience in development and asset management, all investments are treated with a hands-on approach, with an eye towards creatively unlocking value and driving asset-level expertise.  
  
Through the principals’ proprietary relationships of owners, borrowers, borrower advisers, and lending partners and unique structuring capabilities and risk mitigation strategies, Churchill has been able to establish a strong market presence and continues to see strong deal flow across various asset classes in New York.

AASHTO Materials Reference Laboratory (AMRL)
============================================

[](https://www.linkedin.com/company/amrl)

[Get verified emails for AASHTO Materials Reference Laboratory (AMRL) employees\
------------------------------------------------------------------------------](javascript:;)

*   [Profile](https://contactout.com/company/aashto-materials-reference-laboratory-amrl-1514359)
    
*   [Email Format](https://contactout.com/company/aashto-materials-reference-laboratory-amrl-email-format-1514359)
    

About AASHTO Materials Reference Laboratory (AMRL)
--------------------------------------------------

Follow us on LinkedIn as AASHTO re:source. https://www.linkedin.com/company/aashto-re-source  
  
On August 22, 2016, the AASHTO Materials Reference Laboratory (AMRL) became AASHTO re:source.  
  
For over 50 years we have been promoting quality in the construction material testing industry. What started with laboratory assessments and proficiency samples, expanded with the creation of the AASHTO Accreditation Program. More recently, we’ve responded to customer needs by providing learning tools and being industry advocates. In cooperation with the FHWA and Harpers Enterprise, we’ve also created customized training for state engineers. Now, we are launching our first-ever Technical Exchange in March 2017, as an opportunity for the industry to learn from subject matter experts and share ideas with their peers.  
  
This natural evolution has prompted us to rework the way we present ourselves to our customers. The AASHTO re:source name is part of a larger rebranding effort and reflects our evolution over the past 50 years.  
  
Although the AMRL name has changed, the AASHTO Accreditation Program name has remained the same. Agencies requiring AASHTO accreditation do not need to reword their specifications.  
  
AASHTO re:source will continue to respond to customer needs for assessments, proficiency samples, accreditation, and more. We remain committed to being a resource to our customers by making our expert knowledge more accessible through on-line and on-site training, relevant articles and more.

Media.net has offices across New York, Los Angeles, Dubai, Zurich, Mumbai, and Bangalore. Media.net’s US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.

Tifani McCann serves as the Vice President and Chief Data & Analytics Officer at Otsuka Pharmaceutical Companies (U.S.), where she plays a pivotal role in shaping the organization's data-driven strategies. With a robust background in the pharmaceutical industry, Tifani leads the centralized data and analytics team, focusing on harnessing data assets across various business lines, including Commercial, R&D, and Enterprise Functions. Her expertise in clinical data management and deep understanding of regulatory frameworks, such as 21 CFR Part 11, enable her to develop innovative data solutions that align with both scientific and business objectives.  
  
Under Tifani's leadership, Otsuka has embarked on key projects that emphasize the integration of data analytics into clinical trials and operational processes, particularly in the realm of infectious diseases. By establishing effective operating models, she has fostered a culture of collaboration and creativity, driving measurable business impact and operational efficiencies. Her strategic vision encompasses not only the procurement of essential external data resources but also the development of a comprehensive enterprise Data and Data Science Strategy that empowers cross-functional teams to leverage insights for informed decision-making.  
  
Tifani's intuitive leadership style and commitment to excellence have positioned her as a transformative force within the organization. Her ability to navigate complex challenges and embrace data as a strategic asset underscores her dedication to advancing Otsuka's mission of delivering innovative healthcare solutions. As she continues to elevate the role of data and analytics in the life sciences sector, Tifani remains a key player in driving the future of pharmaceutical advancements.

What services does TrustArc offer for data privacy compliance?

TrustArc provides a comprehensive suite of services designed to help organizations comply with global data privacy regulations. These services include Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), data mapping, and privacy risk assessments. Additionally, TrustArc offers privacy management software that helps organizations manage their privacy programs effectively, ensuring compliance with laws such as GDPR, CCPA, and COPPA.

How does TrustArc support organizations in managing GDPR compliance?

TrustArc offers a variety of solutions specifically tailored for GDPR compliance. This includes tools for conducting data inventories, managing individual rights requests, and implementing cookie consent mechanisms. TrustArc's platform also provides resources for ongoing monitoring of compliance status and updates on regulatory changes, ensuring that organizations remain compliant as laws evolve.

What industries does TrustArc serve?

TrustArc serves a wide range of industries, including technology, healthcare, finance, retail, and education. Each industry faces unique data privacy challenges, and TrustArc tailors its solutions to meet the specific regulatory requirements and privacy concerns of these sectors. This industry-specific approach ensures that organizations receive relevant guidance and tools for effective privacy management.

Can TrustArc help with international data transfers and compliance with Privacy Shield?

Yes, TrustArc provides solutions for managing international data transfers, including compliance with the EU-U.S. Privacy Shield framework. TrustArc assists organizations in implementing Model Contract Clauses (MCCs) and provides guidance on best practices for cross-border data transfers. This ensures that organizations can legally transfer personal data while maintaining compliance with applicable privacy laws.

What is the role of TrustArc in dispute resolution related to data privacy?

About Azini Capital Partners
----------------------------

Azini Capital is a UK based private equity firm that specialises in acquiring portfolios of private and public technology companies from historical investors and shareholders (secondary transactions).  
  
Azini Capital typically acquires significant minority stakes and prefers to hold investments for a number of years - providing additional funding if required - in order to maximize the growth, development and ultimate value of the companies.  
  
The firm has completed a series of transactions since its formation in 2004 including the acquisition of portfolios from Apax Partners, J.P.Morgan and CLS Holdings plc. and has enjoyed a number of successful exits.  
  
We focus on quality assets with good future prospects; providing a solution for historical investors in quality companies who - typically for structural or strategic reasons – are looking to achieve liquidity.  
  
Our approach allows management and other investors to 'play forward', giving the company more money and time in order to deliver greater upside. Our funds maintain significant reserves of fresh capital in order that we can support the development and growth of portfolio companies. Following the investment we work in close partnership with management teams, the board and the company's advisors to help companies realise their full potential.

The Company operates an innovative online energy e-commerce and investment platform, www.solarbao.com which enables individuals and institutional investors to purchase innovative PV-based investment and other products; as well as www.solartao.com, a B2B e-commerce platform offering a range of PV products for both upstream and downstream suppliers and customers.  
  
The Company has its operating headquarters in Shanghai and maintains global operations in Asia, Europe, North America and Australia.

About SEED School for Executive Education and Development
---------------------------------------------------------

SEED School for Executive Education and Development, headquartered in Budapest, Hungary, is redefining the landscape of business education in Central and Eastern Europe (CEE). Founded on the principle that world-class education should be accessible beyond the confines of prestigious Western institutions, SEED aims to harness the region's rich talent pool and foster local career growth. Since the inception of its first Business Leadership Program in 2014, which welcomed just 18 participants, SEED has experienced remarkable growth, now boasting over 2,000 alumni and a diverse program portfolio that caters to all organizational levels—from emerging talents to seasoned executives.  
  
The school prides itself on integrating Ivy League business education with a regional focus, ensuring that participants not only gain international best practices but also understand the unique challenges and opportunities within the CEE market. With partnerships from notable organizations like MOL and OTP Bank, SEED has established itself as a trusted partner to over 300 companies, enhancing regional competitiveness and nurturing a vibrant professional network. Notably, more than 30% of its participants come from outside Hungary, underscoring its appeal as a global educational hub.  
  
As SEED School for Executive Education and Development continues to expand its offerings, including a comprehensive teachers list featuring industry experts and thought leaders, it remains committed to its vision: to become the premier choice for executives in the CEE region and to be recognized among the top European business schools within the next decade. Through its innovative programs and dedication to excellence, SEED is shaping the future of business leadership in the region.

About Legal Aid at Work
-----------------------

Legal Aid at Work promotes the rights and economic self-sufficiency of low-wage workers and marginalized communities through free legal services, education, and advocacy at the local, state, and national level. Using the law as a tool, we help low-wage workers create the best possible future for themselves and their families.  
  
As one of the few legal aid organizations providing direct community legal services as well as representation in court, impact litigation, and policy advocacy, we address the full spectrum of employment-related issues for our clients including:  
  
\-- Unpaid minimum or overtime wages;  
\-- Denial of medical / family leave;  
\-- Denial of disability accommodations; and  
\-- Discrimination on the basis of race, national origin, immigration status, language, gender, sexual orientation, or disability.  
  
Legal Aid at Work focuses on six program areas: disability rights; gender equity; national origin, immigration, and language rights; racial equality; wage and hour enforcement litigation; and community legal services. We help our clients and our community by providing a wide range of services, including limited and full legal representation; pre-litigation resolutions; representation before administrative and governmental entities; expert testimony before legislative bodies; and technical support.

About European Research Council (ERC)
-------------------------------------

Set up in 2007 by the European Union, the European Research Council (ERC) aims to stimulate scientific excellence in Europe by encouraging competition for funding between the very best, creative researchers of any nationality and age from anywhere in the world. As part of Horizon 2020, the EU programme for research and innovation for 2014 to 2020, the ERC has a total budget of over €13 billion. The ERC has an 'investigator-driven'​, 'bottom-up'​ approach, which allows researchers to identify new opportunities in any field of research (Physical Sciences and Engineering, Life Sciences and Social Sciences and Humanities). On the sole basis of excellence, the ERC provides attractive long-term funding to individual top scientists and their teams to pursue ground-breaking research.  
The funded projects are expected to lead to scientific advances and to set clear and inspirational targets for frontier research across the world.  
  
By supporting the brightest minds, the ERC grants help to bring about new and unpredictable scientific and technological discoveries in Europe.

About Paul Martin's American Grill
----------------------------------

When restaurateur Paul Fleming moved to Napa Valley and tasted the difference in eating fresh, unadulterated food straight from the land, there was no going back. “You don’t know what better is until you actually experience it,” he recalls, and was then determined to offer back-to-basics eating all across America.  
  
Chef and restaurateur Brian Bennett shared Paul’s vision. Over dinner one evening, both men celebrated the flavor of clean, “real food” ingredients, but lamented how most Americans don’t know where their food comes from and have difficulty accessing higher-quality ingredients.  
  
Thus began their quest to change America’s food story.  
  
Paul and Brian knew this story must start at the source. They traveled to and partnered with renowned vineyards for exclusive wines, California cattle ranchers for humanely raised beef, and calamari fishermen in Rhode Island for sustainably harvested seafood. Their Never-Settle Sourcing philosophy meant collaborating with the most conscientious and talented farmers and purveyors they could find. And just like that, a new restaurant concept was born.  
  
Paul Martin’s American Grill is on a mission to make the food America loves set to a higher standard—always without hormones or antibiotics—and all served in an environment of convivial and remarkable hospitality. We warmly invite you to enjoy America’s New Food Story.

About Vera Lynn

Dame Vera Lynn, born Vera Margaret Welch on March 20, 1917, was a legendary English singer and entertainer who captivated audiences around the world with her stirring vocals and uplifting spirit. Often referred to as the "Forces' Sweetheart" due to her popularity during World War II, Lynn's music became a source of hope and inspiration for soldiers and civilians alike.  
  
Lynn's career in music began at a young age, as she started performing in public at the age of seven and was soon recognized for her exceptional talent. Her big break came in 1935 when she was discovered by bandleader Joe Loss, which led to her first professional recording, "Up the Wooden Hill to Bedfordshire." Her sweet, angelic voice and captivating stage presence quickly made her a beloved figure in the British music scene.  
  
During World War II, Vera Lynn's music played a crucial role in boosting morale and lifting the spirits of the British people. She became the voice of hope and resilience with her iconic songs such as "We'll Meet Again" and "The White Cliffs of Dover," which struck a chord with the troops abroad and their families back home. Lynn's heartfelt performances and messages of unity and courage resonated deeply with the public, earning her a special place in the hearts of the nation.  
  
After the war, Vera Lynn continued to enchant audiences with her timeless music and endearing personality. She embarked on numerous concert tours and made regular appearances on radio and television, showcasing her versatility as a performer. Her songs continued to inspire and uplift people of all ages, cementing her status as a cultural icon in the UK and beyond.  
  
In addition to her musical career, Vera Lynn was also a devoted philanthropist and humanitarian. She dedicated her time and energy to various charitable causes, particularly those supporting veterans and their families. Her unwavering commitment to helping others earned her the respect and admiration of countless individuals, further solidifying her legacy as a beloved figure in British society.  
  
In recognition of her outstanding contributions to music and her tireless efforts in charitable work, Vera Lynn was appointed a Dame Commander of the Order of the British Empire in 1975. This prestigious honor underscored her significant impact on the cultural landscape of the UK and her enduring legacy as a symbol of hope, resilience, and compassion.  
  
Throughout her remarkable career, Vera Lynn remained a beacon of light and inspiration, touching the hearts of countless people with her beautiful voice and unwavering optimism. Her timeless music continues to resonate with audiences today, serving as a poignant reminder of the power of music to unite, heal, and uplift the human spirit.  
  
In her later years, Vera Lynn continued to be a beloved figure, maintaining a strong connection with her fans and remaining active in her charitable endeavors. She passed away on June 18, 2020, at the age of 103, leaving behind a rich legacy of music and philanthropy that will continue to inspire generations to come.  
  
Dame Vera Lynn's extraordinary career as an English singer and entertainer has left an indelible mark on the world of music and the hearts of those who had the privilege of experiencing her timeless performances. Her unwavering spirit and dedication to spreading joy and hope through her music will forever be remembered, ensuring her legacy will live on for generations to come.

About Glenmark Pharmaceuticals
------------------------------

Glenmark Pharmaceuticals is a worldwide, integrated, and innovation-driven organization with a presence across geographies, committed to enriching lives worldwide.  
Innovation is deeply embedded in Glenmark’s culture; it is how we differentiate ourselves in our key markets and create great value for our stakeholders.  
  
Over the last 45 years, we have journeyed along the high road to innovation, evolving from a generics company to an innovation-driven, integrated, global pharmaceutical company.  
  
We have established a strong global Branded Generics, Generics, Specialty, and OTC business and have established a significant presence in the therapy areas of dermatology, respiratory medicine, and oncology.  
  
Our generics business serves over 80 countries, while our API business sells products in over 65 countries worldwide.  
  
Our 14 state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and 4 R&D centres help us create breakthrough therapies for the global patient population while our global team of 15,000+ employees, including 1,400+ employees in research and development, is committed to enriching lives around the world.  
  
Glenmark’s core values of Achievement, Respect and Knowledge impart a sense of organizational unity that drives our growth.  
  
As part of our CSR commitment, we have positively impacted the lives of over 2.6 million people, with a particular focus on child and maternal health. The Joy of Giving program has seen over 62,400 hours of voluntary service from our employees in over 33 countries.

About Mack Sigman

Mack Sigman currently serves as the SharePoint Subject Matter Expert (SME) at Nationwide IT Services, Inc., where he plays a pivotal role in supporting the United States Geological Survey (USGS) contract. With a unique blend of technical acumen and project management skills, Mack has established himself as a key figure in the realm of enterprise content management and cloud computing. His expertise in SharePoint and enterprise portals allows him to design and implement robust solutions that enhance collaboration and streamline workflows within the USGS.  
  
In his capacity as Chief Barrista, Mack also brings a creative flair to the workplace, fostering a culture of innovation and teamwork. He is instrumental in leading key projects that leverage Microsoft CRM and ASP.NET technologies, ensuring that the IT infrastructure aligns with the evolving needs of the agency. His proficiency in Windows Server and service-oriented architecture (SOA) further enhances his ability to deliver scalable and efficient solutions.  
  
Mack’s commitment to excellence is evident in his approach to problem-solving and his ability to herd the complexities of IT projects into cohesive, actionable plans. His deep understanding of CSS and Visual Basic complements his technical toolkit, enabling him to develop user-friendly interfaces that improve user experience. As a thought leader in the industry, Mack Sigman continues to drive forward-thinking initiatives that not only meet the immediate requirements of the USGS but also anticipate future technological advancements in the field.

About Lee Glynn

Lee Glynn is a dynamic leader and Mental Health Speaker who currently serves as the Founding Director of Core Healthcare Group. With over 26 years of extensive experience in the recruitment industry, Lee has honed his expertise across various sectors, including healthcare and executive recruitment. His role involves leading a dedicated team of recruitment professionals who specialize in delivering innovative and tailored workforce solutions to meet the unique needs of clients in diverse industries.  
  
At YouTube, Lee leverages his personal journey and professional insights to advocate for mental health awareness and support. Having faced his own struggles with depression and anxiety, which began with a suicide attempt at 17, Lee understands the critical importance of open dialogue about mental health. He emphasizes the power of communication in managing mental health challenges, a message he passionately shares through his platform.  
  
Key projects that Lee has been involved in include developing strategic communications initiatives aimed at fostering a supportive environment for individuals facing mental health issues. His skills in operations management, strategic planning, and candidate rapport have been instrumental in creating programs that not only address workforce needs but also promote mental well-being within organizations. By integrating mental health advocacy into his recruitment strategies, Lee is not only transforming the landscape of workforce solutions but also inspiring others to prioritize mental health in their personal and professional lives. Through his work, he continues to make a profound impact, encouraging individuals to seek help and fostering a culture of openness and support.

Enabling Western Australian athletes to achieve international sporting success.

Sporting Champions: Western Australian athletes achieve international success and are admired for their character.  
  
Guiding Principles  
WAIS will pursue its Purpose and develop strategy guided by the following principles:  
  
• Principle 1. International Focus: WAIS will prioritise resource allocation to support athlete performance at the international level.  
  
• Principle 2. Partner to Value Add: WAIS will invest in and partner National Sports Organisations (NSOs) that provide high calibre national leadership; it will allocate its resources to enhance the support provided by them to WA athletes.  
  
• Principle 3. Western Australian Significance: WAIS will give priority to sports important to the Western Australian community.  
  
• Principle 4. Community Values: High performance athletes are role models for the community and their behaviour should reflect an understanding of this responsibility.  
  
• Principle 5. Athlete wellbeing and safety: WAIS will make decisions and take actions that are at all times considerate of athlete mental and physical wellbeing and safety.  
  
• Principle 6. Government Policy Alignment: WAIS will align with Western Australian Government policy and be responsive to Federal Government sports policy.  
  
Our Values  
Our culture of Striving for Excellence is lived through the behaviours of athletes and staff that demonstrate:  
  
• PASSION  
• INTEGRITY  
• QUALITY  
• TEAMWORK

About ADMA Biologics, Inc.
--------------------------

ADMA Biologics is an end-to-end commercial biopharmaceutical company dedicated to manufacturing, marketing and developing specialty plasma-derived biologics for the treatment of immunodeficient patients at risk for infection and others at risk for certain infectious diseases. ADMA currently manufactures and markets three United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved plasma-derived biologics for the treatment of immune deficiencies and the prevention of certain infectious diseases: BIVIGAM® (immune globulin intravenous, human) for the treatment of primary humoral immunodeficiency (PI); ASCENIV™ (immune globulin intravenous, human – slra 10% liquid) for the treatment of PI; and NABI-HB® (hepatitis B immune globulin, human) to provide enhanced immunity against the hepatitis B virus. ADMA manufactures its immune globulin products at its FDA-licensed plasma fractionation and purification facility located in Boca Raton, Florida. Through its ADMA BioCenters subsidiary, ADMA also operates as an FDA-approved source plasma collector in the U.S., which provides a portion of its blood plasma for the manufacture of its products. ADMA’s mission is to manufacture, market and develop specialty plasma-derived, human immune globulins targeted to niche patient populations for the treatment and prevention of certain infectious diseases and management of immune compromised patient populations who suffer from an underlying immune deficiency, or who may be immune compromised for other medical reasons. ADMA has received U.S. Patents: 9,107,906, 9,714,283, 9,815,886, 9,969,793 and 10,259,865 related to certain aspects of its products and product candidates. For more information, please visit www.admabiologics.com.

Since 1932, P&O Cruises Australia has offered Aussies and Kiwis the opportunity to take to the seas and have the holiday experience of a lifetime. Over the years we’ve led the Australasian cruise industry and established ourselves as the region’s only home brand and experts in delivering memorable cruise holidays. In August 2022, P&O Cruises Australia welcomes Pacific Encounter® to Brisbane, with Pacific Adventure® arriving in Sydney in October 2022.  
  
P&O’s sister line, Princess Cruises, entered the market in 2002 and has grown to five, year-round home ported ships and recently introduced Coral Princess to Australian waters, based out of Brisbane. Known as the resident ‘fun ships’, Carnival Cruise Line recently announced Carnival Luminosa will be joining the ‘fun’ in Brisbane from November 2022 and we couldn’t be more excited!  
  
We have an impressive team of 400 people shore side, our positive company culture has won us national recognition with being listed in the top Great Places to Work for the last 3 years. We have many divisions, from marketing, sales and pricing, through to corporate affairs, finance and IT. Our open plan head office in Chatswood promotes inclusivity, teamwork & transparent leadership. We have a flexible work approach with our team enjoying work from home opportunities, as well as a compressed fortnight (75 hours over a 9 days fortnight) approach across many departments.  
  
We successfully made cruising the fastest growing sector of Australian & New Zealand tourism; and made our region the fastest growing cruise market in the world. It’s safe to say, the future is looking bright.

About Crane Currency
--------------------

OUR HISTORY  
Crane Currency is one of the longest-standing companies within the banknote industry. We have been making paper, developing security features and printing banknotes for more than 200 years.  
  
Crane was founded in 1801 by Zenas Crane in Dalton, Massachusetts, USA. His legacy has been a succession of seven generations of family owners and managers with a mission to develop highly durable and secure paper. US currency paper, first produced by Crane in 1879, in many ways, set the standards for today’s range of banknote substrates.  
  
INTERNATIONAL OPERATIONS OF CRANE CURRENCY  
International operations of Crane Currency is located in Tumba, Sweden. Our unique one-site paper and printing facility in Tumba, gives our customers the unique opportunity to have their banknotes, designed, and printed in the same secure facility where the paper and embedded security features are produced.  
  
In December 2017, the company commenced operations in a new banknote production facility in Malta. It is one of the most modern and advanced banknote printing facilities in the world.  
  
OUR VISION  
Our vision of the future is simple and clear – cash will continue to remain the single most preferred payments instrument, so long as our industry continues to evolve and embrace innovation. Our research and development programs, advanced manufacturing facilities and comprehensive range of banknote products and services are symbols of our commitment to this future.

About Foremost Group
--------------------

Foremost Group is an American shipping company with offices in the United States and Asia. Founded in New York in 1964 by Dr. James S.C. Chao and his late wife, Mrs. Ruth Mulan Chu Chao, the company today is a global leader in the dry bulk shipping industry and has earned a worldwide reputation for its commitment to exceptional service and performance while always holding itself to the highest ethical standards.  
  
For over 50 years, Foremost Group has maintained its core values – honor, integrity and performance – as the ingredients for success. It has earned its sterling reputation from partners, including charterers, banks, shipyards and others, for its faithful devotion to Foremost Group’s mission statement: “Our mission is to remain a premier provider of ocean transportation services and a model of excellence for our industry.”  
  
Foremost Group is an industry leader in incorporating fuel-efficient designs and technology in its fleet of modern and eco-friendly dry bulk carriers. The company ships more than 15 million tons of goods, including a wide variety of dry bulk products including grains, soybeans, iron ore, coal and other similar products, around the world for its blue-chip clientele every year. Foremost ensures the highest-quality service by exclusively managing ships that have been built to its high standards and specifications. Foremost does not manage second-hand or third-party ships.  
  
Since its founding, Foremost Group has incorporated eco-friendly designs and technology in the company’s fleet which today includes some of the world’s largest and most eco- friendly bulk carriers. This is in keeping with Dr. Chao’s steadfast belief that treating the environment with respect is not only a good business practice, but also a solemn responsibility. Foremost Group is proud to have an industry-leading track record on environmental issues for over 50 years.

3\. We are inclusive.  
4\. We are curious and have heart.  
5\. We act with a spirit of ingenuity.

We welcome anyone and everyone into our global family and proudly celebrate an environment where individuality is embraced, equal opportunities thrive, and everyone is supported to reach their greatest potential.  
  
VF Corporation  
VF Corporation is one of the world’s largest apparel, footwear and accessories companies connecting people to the lifestyles, activities and experiences they cherish most through a family of iconic outdoor, active and workwear brands including Vans®, The North Face®, Timberland® and Dickies®. Our purpose is to power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. We believe that when you discover the difference between a career and a calling, you get so much more out of life. ### Frequently Asked Questions about Inventys Inc.

Who is the CEO of Svante?

Afranio Torres is the CEO of Svante. To contact Afranio Torres email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
.

What types of industries can benefit from Svante's carbon capture technology?

Svante's carbon capture technology is designed to support a wide range of industries that produce significant CO2 emissions. This includes sectors such as cement, steel, natural gas, and other heavy industries. By integrating our filters and rotary contactor machines, these industries can effectively capture and manage their carbon emissions, contributing to cleaner production processes and compliance with environmental regulations.

How does Svante's carbon capture technology work?

Svante utilizes a unique process involving filters and rotary contactor machines to capture CO2 from industrial emissions and the atmosphere. The technology works by passing flue gas through specialized filters that selectively absorb CO2. Once the filters are saturated, the captured CO2 is released through a regeneration process, allowing the filters to be reused. This efficient cycle not only reduces greenhouse gas emissions but also enables the potential for carbon storage or utilization.

What are the environmental benefits of using Svante's solutions?

The primary environmental benefit of Svante's solutions is the significant reduction of CO2 emissions from industrial processes. By capturing and removing CO2, our technology helps mitigate climate change and supports global efforts to achieve net-zero emissions. Additionally, our solutions promote cleaner energy production and can facilitate the transition to a circular economy by enabling carbon utilization in various applications.

Can Svante's technology be integrated into existing industrial processes?

Yes, Svante's carbon capture technology is designed for easy integration into existing industrial processes. Our systems can be customized to fit the specific needs and configurations of various facilities, ensuring minimal disruption during installation. This adaptability allows industries to enhance their sustainability efforts without overhauling their entire operations.

What is the potential for carbon storage or utilization after capturing CO2?

After capturing CO2, there are several pathways for its storage or utilization. The captured CO2 can be stored underground in geological formations, a process known as carbon sequestration, which helps prevent it from re-entering the atmosphere. Alternatively, captured CO2 can be utilized in various applications, such as producing synthetic fuels, chemicals, or even in enhanced oil recovery. Svante's technology supports both options, allowing industries to choose the most suitable approach for their operations.

How does Svante contribute to the clean energy transition?

Svante plays a crucial role in the clean energy transition by providing innovative carbon capture solutions that enable industries to reduce their carbon footprint. By capturing CO2 emissions, we help facilitate the shift towards cleaner energy sources and promote sustainable practices across various sectors. Our technology not only aids in compliance with environmental regulations but also supports the development of a low-carbon economy, making it easier for industries to align with global climate goals.

About Liven Creative
--------------------

Liven Creative is a results-focused branding agency with a decade-long track record of delivering positive ROI and tangible benefits for ambitious clients in manufacturing, construction, technology, law, and horticulture.  
  
Though each project is unique, our clients are united by a need to respond to significant and sometimes urgent change. We support them in overcoming their challenges by providing expertise across one or more of these specialisms: brand strategy, brand identity, brand activation, and brand aftercare.  
  
We call our approach Deliberately Different Branding.  
  
Deliberate: because we help clients build brands with intention. Not skin-deep or style for style’s sake, but constructed on a robust foundation of strategic insight and precisely crafted to be fit for purpose, attractive, memorable, and easy to implement.  
  
Different: because establishing a clear and defensible position in the hearts and minds of stakeholders is the primary objective of branding. We increase awareness, inspire preference, and nurture loyalty by creating brands that are authentic to themselves, relevant and engaging to their audiences, and distinctive from their competitors.  
  
Great results emanate from a working culture of collaboration, honesty, mutual respect and trust. We cultivate consensus and align ambitions, helping our clients scale-up effectively, confident they have a strong brand to support their future success.

About WMF Group
---------------

WMF, which is short for Württembergische Metallwarenfabrik, is a leading premium provider of household products, professional coffee machines and hotel equipment. WMF stands for innovation based on tradition and provides convincing engineering and design "Made in Germany".  
  
Under the WMF, Silit and Kaiser brands, the company offers products for preparing, cooking, eating, drinking and baking for use at home. Business customers, in particular from the restaurant and hotel industry, have access to product ranges for coffee preparation, as well as the set table and buffet under the WMF, Schaerer, Curtis and Hepp brands.  
  
WMF is represented with its products in over 120 countries and has more than 6000 employees. In Germany, Austria and Switzerland, but also in the rest of Europe and worldwide, e.g. in China, WMF operates a total of around 350 of its own shops. The company was founded in 1853 in Geislingen an der Steige and has been part of the French Groupe SEB since the end of 2016.

What types of professional coffee machines does WMF offer?

WMF offers a wide range of professional coffee machines designed for various settings, including cafes, restaurants, and hotels. Their product line includes fully automatic coffee machines, espresso machines, and modular systems that can be customized to meet specific needs. Each machine is engineered for high performance, reliability, and ease of use, ensuring that businesses can serve high-quality coffee consistently.

How does WMF ensure the quality of its cookware and small domestic appliances (SDA)?

WMF maintains strict quality control measures throughout the production process of its cookware and small domestic appliances. The company utilizes high-grade materials, innovative manufacturing techniques, and rigorous testing protocols to ensure durability, safety, and performance. Additionally, WMF products are designed with user-friendly features that enhance the cooking experience, making them a preferred choice for both home cooks and professional chefs.

What industries does WMF serve with its hotel equipment solutions?

WMF provides hotel equipment solutions primarily for the hospitality industry, including hotels, restaurants, and catering services. Their offerings include buffet equipment, tableware, and kitchen appliances that are designed to enhance the dining experience. WMF's products are tailored to meet the demands of high-volume service environments, ensuring that hotels can deliver exceptional quality and efficiency to their guests.

Can WMF customize its products for specific business needs?

Yes, WMF offers customization options for many of its products to better suit the specific needs of businesses. This includes bespoke designs for professional coffee machines and tailored solutions for hotel equipment. WMF's team works closely with clients to understand their requirements and provide solutions that align with their operational goals and brand identity.

What innovations has WMF introduced in the coffee machine market?

WMF has been at the forefront of innovation in the coffee machine market, introducing features such as advanced brewing technology, integrated milk systems, and smart connectivity options. Their machines often include touch-screen interfaces for ease of use, customizable drink settings, and energy-efficient designs. These innovations not only enhance the quality of the beverages produced but also improve the overall user experience for both operators and customers.

Where can I find support or service for WMF products?

WMF provides comprehensive support and service for its products through a network of authorized service partners and customer service channels. Customers can access technical support, maintenance services, and spare parts through WMF's official website or by contacting their customer service team directly. Additionally, WMF offers training programs for operators to ensure optimal use and maintenance of their equipment.

We bring together talent from a wide range of disciplines including immunobiology, drug development, fundraising, commercialization and finance, with decades of experience across big pharma and small biotech, multiple industries and academia. We are passionate about science that pushes the limits, the patients that drive the heart of our work, and the wellness of our employees. We embrace flexibility. If you are looking for a career where you are encouraged to be innovative, challenge the status quo, and have some fun while doing it, Triumvira is the place for you.

About USA Compression
---------------------

USA Compression Partners LP (NYSE: USAC), based in Austin, TX, completed its IPO in January 2013. Founded in 1998, USAC is a growth-oriented MLP that is one of the largest U.S. independent providers of natural gas compression, based on total fleet horsepower of nearly 4 million as of August 2018. USAC operates an infrastructure-oriented asset base that generates stable cash flows underpinned by high utilization rates. USAC provides compression services to the midstream energy sector, primarily in the shales and unconventional resource plays, which have lower producing pressures than conventional reservoirs and where demand is about three times that in conventional areas. USAC also provides gas lift compression services in artificial oil recovery. USAC employs a customer-oriented business philosophy in partnering with a diverse customer base, which is comprised of producers, processors, gatherers and transporters of natural gas and crude oil.

About Renu Ventures
-------------------

Renu Ventures is a venture fund investing into companies that focus on connected, autonomous, shared, & electric transportation and the convergence of transportation with the energy sector of distributed and renewable energy.  
  
We believe in advancing a sustainable economy, that transportation should be electric and shared, reducing emissions and that the future needs clean and affordable energy for all. Renu Ventures achieves these goals through targeted funding of companies that share these values and impact the sustainable energy economy.  
  
Renu Ventures is a venture firm focusing on the convergence of mobility, energy and infrastructure. At Renu Ventures, industry veterans teamed up to apply their expertise to elevate new ventures in this convergence space to the next level. We are not simply providing funding, but connect companies with key industry people and potential clients and contribute management experience, deep market knowledge and a business ecosystem that will assist management of our portfolio companies to overachieve their goals.  
  
What do we invest in?   
Renu Ventures focuses on companies addressing extraordinary business opportunities in the following areas:  
ACES Transportation(Autonomous, Connected, Electric, Shared)  
Distributed Energy Resources - technology and projects  
Mobility as a Service (MaaS)  
Transportation as a Service (TaaS)  
Artificial Intelligence (AI)  
Urban Tech and Infrastructure

About Floris Hooijenga

Floris Hooijenga serves as the Director of Engineered Systems for EMEA & India at Repligen Corporation, where he plays a pivotal role in driving commercial success for large-scale downstream single-use KRM™ Chromatography and KrosFlo Tangential Flow Filtration systems and software solutions. With a robust background in the pharmaceutical industry, Floris is adept at aligning innovative technologies with the evolving needs of customers and patients. His extensive experience encompasses critical areas such as mammalian cell culture, virus filtration, and vaccine production, positioning him as a key player in enhancing bioprocessing efficiency across diverse applications.  
  
At Repligen, Floris is not only responsible for sales metrics and customer relationship management (CRM) but also leads strategic initiatives that foster collaboration and innovation within the industry. His expertise in cell biology and standard operating procedures (SOP) ensures that the solutions provided meet rigorous regulatory standards while optimizing laboratory workflows. Floris is particularly passionate about leveraging engineered systems to streamline processes and improve outcomes in biopharmaceutical manufacturing.  
  
Key projects under his leadership include the development and implementation of tailored filtration solutions that address specific client challenges, thereby enhancing productivity and reducing time-to-market for critical therapies. His results-driven approach and commitment to customer satisfaction have established him as a trusted partner in the bioprocessing landscape, making significant contributions to the advancement of pharmaceutical technologies in the EMEA region and India. Through his work, Floris continues to drive innovation and excellence, ensuring that Repligen remains at the forefront of the bioprocessing industry.

About Road Safety Commission
----------------------------

The Road Safety Commission is a State Government agency with a big vision – to make every journey safe.  
  
Led by Road Safety Commissioner Adrian Warner, the passionate team that make up the Road Safety Commission is committed to reducing the number of people killed or seriously injured on Western Australian roads by at least 50% by 2030.  
  
This could save up to 723 lives and prevent approximately 8,000 people suffering from serious and life-changing injuries over the next decade.  
  
To reach this target and deliver on the priorities set out in Driving Change – the Road Safety Strategy for Western Australia, the team works collaboratively with all levels of government, the private and not-for-profit sectors and the community.  
  
The Road Safety Commission uses the latest data, insights and technology to inform innovative policies, programs and public awareness campaigns addressing the following five priority areas:  
1\. Safe road users  
2\. Safe roads  
3\. Safe vehicles  
4\. Safe speeds  
5\. Post-crash response.  
  
Everybody who uses WA roads is important. The Road Safety Commission works to improve road safety outcomes for all road users ranging from drivers of heavy haulage vehicles and family cars to vulnerable road users including people walking and riding bikes, seniors, people with disability, motorcyclists and eRideable users.

Tim Taylor serves as the Chief Executive Officer of Light Efficient Design, where he leverages his extensive experience in the electrical and electronic manufacturing industry to drive innovation and growth. One of Tim’s key projects includes the development of advanced LED retrofitting solutions that not only enhance energy efficiency but also improve lighting quality across various sectors. His expertise in market planning and product marketing has enabled the company to effectively penetrate new markets and expand its international business footprint. Tim’s strong negotiation skills and experience in contract negotiation have facilitated successful partnerships with key account clients and channel partners, ensuring that Light Efficient Design remains competitive in a rapidly evolving marketplace.  
  
Tim holds a Master’s degree in Business Administration from Keller Graduate School of Management of DeVry University, which has equipped him with a solid foundation in business strategy and operations management. His commitment to fostering a culture of innovation and excellence within the organization has resulted in a robust pipeline of new products and solutions that meet the diverse needs of customers. As a thought leader in the lighting industry, Tim continues to advocate for the adoption of smart lighting controls and energy-efficient practices, positioning Light Efficient Design at the forefront of the transition to sustainable energy solutions.

About Vera Rubin

Vera Rubin was an American astronomer whose groundbreaking work revolutionized our understanding of the universe. Born on July 23, 1928, in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, Rubin had an early interest in science and astronomy. She attended Vassar College, where she majored in astronomy and physics, and then went on to pursue a Ph.D. at Cornell University, becoming one of the few women in the field at the time.  
  
Rubin's most significant contribution to the field of astronomy was her work on dark matter. In the 1970s, she and her colleague Kent Ford made a series of observations of spiral galaxies that led them to propose the existence of dark matter, a mysterious substance that makes up the majority of the mass in the universe. Their observations showed that the stars in these galaxies were moving at speeds that could not be accounted for by the visible matter alone, leading to the conclusion that there must be an unseen source of mass affecting their motion.  
  
This discovery was a major breakthrough in our understanding of the universe and has since become a cornerstone of modern astrophysics. Rubin's work laid the foundation for much of the research that followed, and her findings have had a profound impact on our understanding of the cosmos. Her work on dark matter also inspired a new wave of research and experimentation, as scientists around the world sought to understand this elusive substance.  
  
In addition to her work on dark matter, Rubin also made significant contributions to our understanding of the dynamics of galaxies and the larger structure of the universe. Her observations of the rotation of galaxies provided crucial insights into the distribution and movement of matter in the cosmos, furthering our understanding of how galaxies form and evolve over time.  
  
One of Rubin's most enduring legacies is her impact on the role of women in science. Throughout her career, she faced discrimination and sexism, but she persevered and became a trailblazer for women in astronomy. Her determination and resilience paved the way for future generations of female scientists, and she remains a source of inspiration for women in STEM fields.  
  
Rubin's work has been widely recognized and celebrated, earning her numerous accolades and honors throughout her career. She was the recipient of the National Medal of Science, the Gold Medal of the Royal Astronomical Society, and the Bruce Medal, among many other awards. In 1993, she became the second woman ever to receive the prestigious Royal Society Medal, a testament to the impact of her contributions to the field of astronomy.  
  
Vera Rubin's life and work continue to have a lasting impact on the field of astronomy. Her groundbreaking discoveries have reshaped our understanding of the universe, and her advocacy for women in science has left a lasting legacy. Through her work and her example, she inspired future generations of scientists to pursue their passions and push the boundaries of knowledge. Rubin's contributions to the field of astronomy have solidified her place as one of the most influential figures in the history of astrophysics, and her legacy will continue to inspire and shape the future of the field for years to come.

Founded in 1936, Texas Trust is a community credit union serving more than 114,000 members. With over $1.2 billion in assets, Texas Trust serves the Greater DFW area with 22 total branches. Our commitment to service has earned us multiple awards in every community we call home. This credit union is federally insured by the National Credit Union Administration.  
  
CAREER OPPORTUNITIES  
  
We at Texas Trust firmly believe that our employees drive the success of the credit union. With success in mind as the ultimate goal, we strive to create and provide an environment that offers challenging, stimulating and financially rewarding opportunities.

About Nobles Holding
--------------------

Nobles is an international holding company with interests in the real estate, automotive and technology sectors. Combined with its subsidiaries and affiliates, it employs more than a hundred personnel and part-time staff; and it owns or manages over $2 billion in assets and shares worldwide. Omar Ayesh, a Canadian entrepreneur, investor, and philanthropist established Nobles in 2008 and serves as its Chairman.  
  
The group’s investment strategy focuses exclusively on projects and services that possess unique attributes. Examples include an automotive trading platform online that integrates transactions and transportation of vehicles, as service as yet unavailable to the sector. In the property sector, the group’s subsidiary owns properties in the Middle East and United States in prime locations within proximity of cosmopolitan areas and key airports with uncommon architectural features.  
  
Nobles and its subsidiaries have an active Corporate Social Responsibility platform, with each company allocating a portion of its budget to philanthropic and community activities. This includes housing and healthcare programs for the underprivileged, scholarships, microfinance, debt relief, refugee assistance, and even subsidizing group weddings for those unable to afford the costs.  
  
The group also believes in raising standards of commercial accountability, whether through corporate governance or official bodies. It has sponsored the establishment of the Global Justice Foundation, an organization geared towards promoting the implementation of business ethics and standards of corporate governance worldwide. The Chairman’s experience with corruption, intimidation and abuse in the financial dealings of companies and individuals, sometimes aided by low ranking government officials, inspired the GJF’s formation.

About Channel Control Merchants, LLC
------------------------------------

Channel Control Merchants, LLC is an extreme value retailer and exporter of brand-sensitive secondary market inventories through physical retail and wholesale channels. Its mission is to improve lives and communities in a sustainable way. Unlike web-based or warehouse-only intermediaries, CCM utilizes scan-based SKU-level technology to sell products through its network of physical stores located across the Southeast, Texas, and Canada. CCM’s platform gives brands full transparency and control of their returns and excess inventory through the entire recommerce cycle, all the way to the end consumer.  
  
The Company sources inventories from major retailers and manufacturers and processes the merchandise through its reverse logistics facilities, keeping over 90 million items out of landfills each year. The Company meets its suppliers’ specific geographic distribution requirements for resale by selling through its more than 4 million square feet of retail space. The Company’s retail division has three banners: Dirt Cheap, Treasure Hunt, and Dirt Cheap Building Supplies across 100+ stores located in Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee, Texas, and Ontario, Canada. The stores provide a unique “treasure hunting” shopping experience by offering a wide variety of brand-name merchandise across multiple categories under one roof at extreme savings.

About Festicket
---------------

Lyte, the technology platform reimagining e-commerce for live events, has acquired the Festicket and Event Genius assets in a move that represents an exciting coming together of services and team worldwide, bringing much-needed solutions to the global promoter community.  
  
The Festicket and Event Genius asset acquisition enables Lyte to offer comprehensive, fan-friendly ecommerce solutions for live events anywhere on earth alongside a broad expansion of technology and services.  
  
Who are Lyte?  
  
In 2012, Lyte founder Ant Taylor attended a sold-out Olympic Games event with half-empty stands while hundreds of desperate fans stood outside seeking tickets. Inspired by this experience, Ant created Lyte to allow fans to easily return tickets they couldn't use and help other fans get verified tickets to events of their dreams.  
  
Lyte enables event organisers, venues and artists to enhance their ticketing, ensure shows are full and keep fans happy by providing a safe, official reservation system whilst allowing fans to return tickets to the official point of purchase for a fair price.  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
  
About Festicket  
  
Founded in 2012, Festicket is the world's largest platform for discovering and booking festival trips. In 2019 Festicket completed the acquisition of multi-award winning ticketing and cashless POS platform Event Genius, and the related Ticket Arena consumer website and brand.  
  
The new joint venture created a platform for organisers and fans alike, combining ticketing, marketing, travel, access control and cashless payment solutions in one end-to-end solution.

About Conor Flannigan

Conor Flannigan currently serves as a Geographic Information System (GIS) Specialist with the Office of Resilience and Emergency Management (OREM) at the Oregon Department of Human Services. In this pivotal role, Conor leverages his expertise in GIS to enhance emergency management strategies and improve community resilience. His work involves utilizing advanced ArcGIS products to analyze spatial data, create detailed maps, and develop visualizations that inform decision-making processes during emergencies. By integrating GIS technology with emergency management practices, Conor plays a crucial role in ensuring that resources are allocated effectively and that communities are prepared for potential disasters.  
  
In addition to his responsibilities at OREM, Conor is pursuing a Master of Applied Science in Spatial Analysis for Public Health at the prestigious Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. This academic endeavor complements his professional experience, allowing him to explore the intersection of public health, social equity, and sustainability through spatial analysis. His freelance work in GIS analysis and cartography further underscores his commitment to these critical areas, as he focuses on projects that promote equitable access to resources and sustainable practices.  
  
With a strong foundation in full-stack software engineering, Conor brings a unique perspective to his GIS work, utilizing programming skills in JavaScript, SQL, and mobile application development to create innovative solutions. His proficiency in PostgreSQL and Redis enhances his ability to manage and analyze complex datasets, while his knowledge of CSS and Bootstrap allows him to design user-friendly interfaces for GIS applications. As he seeks full-time opportunities in related fields, Conor is poised to make a significant impact in the realm of spatial analysis, emergency management, and public health.

How does Origin ensure the quality of its products?

About Christie Clinic
---------------------

Since 1929, Christie Clinic has been providing the people of east central Illinois with the highest quality health care. We are one of the largest physician-owned, multi-specialty group medical practices in Illinois, but our approach to meeting your health care needs is simple.  
  
Christie Clinic's physicians and staff are known throughout the community for using a truly personal touch with patients. When you have a doctor who takes the time to listen and understand, it makes all the difference in the world. There are over 40 departments and 35 specialties within Christie Clinic, so our physicians and staff can take care of virtually every aspect of your family's health. And when you need a specialist, we can refer you to someone who understands your condition and will provide the best treatment possible.  
  
Plus, we are continually investing in new technology to provide our doctors with the tools they need to best diagnose and treat our patients. In addition to medical technology for your health, we use technology that makes going to the doctor a lot less complicated. Christie Clinic doctors have your medical records on hand at all times, literally, through our electronic medical records system. This system makes your records available throughout Christie Clinic—at every location.  
  
By keeping the best physicians and staff and staying on top of technology, we're making health care a lot easier for everyone involved.  
  
Christie Clinic was named Best Place to Work in the 2019 News-Gazette’s People’s Choice awards.
